functions.label: Deep research (Manus)
functions.desc: For Strategy: Manus opens public web pages about your market and reports what each one says, with its link. Uses Manus credits and takes several minutes.

functions.label: Facebook groups posting
functions.desc: Manus shares a Facebook post in the groups you list, signed in as you, and reads your profiles to learn your brand voice. Posts on your Pages and profiles go out through your connected accounts instead.

functions.label: Building pages & assets
functions.desc: Manus builds your SEO page or a Code & assets asset as one HTML file, from your website, your words and your images. You choose each time; it uses Manus credits.

functions.label: Chat with Manus
functions.desc: Talk to Manus from the assistant chat: your messages go to one Manus task as you type them, and its replies and files come back to the chat. Uses Manus credits.
